function Obj600152_Init(...)
function r_start_under_pressure()

    local r_pressure_couple_husband = 600155
    local r_pressure_couple_wife = 600702
    local r_check_trigger = 600076
    local r_create_baddies_trigger = 600074
    local r_explode_cars_trigger_1 = 600021
    local r_explode_cars_trigger_2 = 600040
    local r_explode_cars_trigger_3 = 600047
    local r_intro_cinematic_trigger = 600698
    local r_legacy_remove_objectives = 600383
    local r_intro_cinematic = 600698
    local r_pressure_objective_officer = 600073
    local r_pressure_change_officer_objective = 600699
    
    Disable(900161)
    Traffic_StreetPatrolSet(-2)
    Disable(r_legacy_remove_objectives) -- to be removed sometime
    
    -- Disable sandbox --
    fz_sandbox_disable_all() 
    
    ----- This disables and removes the big blue marker -----
    Disable(600381)
    HideObject(600381)
    ---------------------------------------------------------
    
    DisableCopAI()
    --TeleportPlayerToZone(600023)
    
    
    --------------------------------
    --StartCinematicObject(600048)
    --Wait(17100)
    --------------------------------
    
    TeleportPlayerToZone(600101)
    Wait(10)
    
    --------------------------------
    -- The cinematic editor wasn't
    -- working, doing it the old
    -- fasioned way
    --------------------------------
    StartFadeIn(500)
    -------------------------------------------------------
    -- Create the thugs that are going to attack
    -- I need to have control on each of them, can't map
    -------------------------------------------------------
    
    local r_pressure_couple_thug1 = SpawnObject("Melee_Enemy_Test", 600705) 
    local r_pressure_couple_thug2 = SpawnObject("Melee_Enemy_Test", 600707) 
    local r_pressure_couple_thug3 = SpawnObject("Crowbar_Enemy", 600706)
    
    local function r_pressure_set_always_updated(id)
        SetAlwaysUpdate(id, true)
    end
    
    r_pressure_couple_wave = {r_pressure_couple_thug1,r_pressure_couple_thug2,r_pressure_couple_thug3}
    r_map(r_pressure_couple_wave, r_pressure_set_always_updated)
    StartCinematic()
    
        
    
        SetObjectUpdateInCinematicSkip(r_pressure_couple_thug1)
        SetObjectUpdateInCinematicSkip(r_pressure_couple_thug2)
        SetObjectUpdateInCinematicSkip(r_pressure_couple_thug3)
        SetObjectUpdateInCinematicSkip(r_pressure_couple_wife)
        SetObjectUpdateInCinematicSkip(r_pressure_couple_husband)
        
        --------------------------------
        -- Start with a pan, Batman says
        -- he was released from the pit
        --------------------------------
        
        --CameraFollowObject(0,"Bip01_Head",-3,2,-1,true,0,"Bip01_Head",0,0,0,true,500)
        --Wait(500)
        --ShowMessage("STR_UNDER_PRESSURE_INTRO_CINE_02",FACE_BATMAN,4500)
        --CameraFollowObject(0,"Bip01_Head",1.5,1,-1,true,0,"Bip01_Head",0,0,0,true,7000)
        --Wait(4000)
        --ShowMessage("STR_UNDER_PRESSURE_INTRO_CINE_03", FACE_BATMAN, 4000)
        --Wait(3000)
        
        -------------------------------------------------------
        -- Continue with a scene from the city,
        -- focus on empty streets
        --
        -- You can't use waypoints unfortunately, so have to 
        -- fake this with a spawned car :(
        -------------------------------------------------------
        
        local r_pressure_empty_street_waypoint1 = 600742
        local r_pressure_empty_street_waypoint2 = 600744 

        local r_pressure_cine_lonely_car1 = SpawnObject("PickUpTruck", r_pressure_empty_street_waypoint1)
        local r_pressure_cine_lonely_car2 = SpawnObject("PickUpTruck", r_pressure_empty_street_waypoint2)
        
        Wait(100)
        
        ShowMessage("STR_UNDER_PRESSURE_INTRO_CINE_02", FACE_BATMAN, 4000)
        SetHudState('Binoculars')
        StartGadgetZoom()
        
            StartMusic("c_1_5_0_2D_part2", false)
        
            GadgetZoomTarget(r_pressure_cine_lonely_car1,0.7,2500,2500,0.5,0,0,0,"")
            Wait(2500)
            --GadgetZoomTarget(r_pressure_cine_lonely_car2,0.8,1000,1000,0.5,0,0,0,"")
            --Wait(1000)
            
            Wait(100)
            
            --ShowMessage("STR_UNDER_PRESSURE_INTRO_CINE_02", FACE_BATMAN, 4000)
            GadgetZoomTarget(r_pressure_couple_thug3,0.8,2500,2500,0.5,0,0,0,"")
            Wait(2500)
            ShowMessage("STR_UNDER_PRESSURE_INTRO_CINE_03", FACE_BATMAN, 7000)
            Wait(3000)
            
            GadgetZoomTarget(r_pressure_couple_husband,0.8,500,500,0.5,0,0,0,"")
            Wait(2000)
            
            Wait(2700)
            ActorSetState(r_pressure_couple_wife, "Aggression_Victim_Idle_Scared_01", false, false, 300)
            KillActor(r_pressure_cine_lonely_car1)
            KillActor(r_pressure_cine_lonely_car2)
            
        StopGadgetZoom(1000)
        Wait(1000)
        SetHudState("HUD")
    EndCinematic()


    Disable(600335)
    StartFadeIn(500)
    
    local function r_pressure_set_cowards(id)
        NPCSetStance(id, -1, "Passive")
    end
    
    r_map(r_pressure_couple_wave, r_pressure_set_cowards)
    
    Wait(300)
    ActorSetState(r_pressure_couple_husband, "Aggression_Victim_Down_Idle")
    DisableInteractionForObject(r_pressure_couple_husband)
    ObjectiveAdd(r_pressure_couple_husband,"objective")
    ShowObjectiveMessage("STR_UNDER_PRESSURE_FIRST_OBJECTIVE",-1,5000,"",true,true)
    SetQuestEnabled(301)
    r_stop_traffic()
    
    r_pressure_killable_resources = {600071,600073,600155,600702}
    KillMusic(3000)
    
end
StartFadeOut(1)
StartIntroStory("under_pressure_intro","r_start_under_pressure",true)
StartMusic("c_1_5_0_2D_part1", false)
PlayAmbience("wayne_manor_ext_up")
StartSoundWithState("sfx_ambiance_wayne_ext_rain", "up", true, 2000)
end

function Obj600388_Init(...)
if not IsQuestRunning(305) then
    Wait(10)
    fz_sandbox_disable_all() 
    PostProcessingEffectAdd("DepthOfField", {focus_actor ="600847", blur_factor ="0.5", blur_range = "10"})
    
    PauseSound("sfx_gotham_rain", 0)
    PauseSound("wayne_manor_ext_up", 0)
    PauseSound("sfx_ambiance_wayne_ext_rain ", 0)
    
    StartCinematicObject(600389)
    Wait(25000)
    PostProcessingEffectRemove("DepthOfField")
    StartFadeIn(500)
    Wait(500)
    --TeleportPlayerToZone(600431)
    --Enable(600481)
    SetQuestAccepted(305)
end
end
